title: Lemon Snow Pudding
directions: Dissolve jello as directed on pkg. Cool & when quite thick beat until foamy. Add whites of eggs beaten stiff & continue beating till it holds its shape. Put aside to set again. Serve c soft custard.
Soft custard: 2 c milk, 2 egg yolks, 1/4 c sugar, 1 tbsp corn starch, 1 tsp. vanilla. Make like any pudding & cool. Pour over jello & serve - serves six.
notes: Serves six
'soft custard' written sideways in the left margin beside the custard ingredients

title: Lemon Snow
ingredients: 2 pkgs (113 g) lemon pie filling powder
directions: In a saucepan combine pie filling, sugar, 2 egg yolks and juice of 2 lemons, (grate rind before juicing lemon). Add warm water. Cook and stir over medium until mixture boils and has thickened. Remove from heat. Stir in butter. Cool.
In a mixing bowl whip egg whites until stiff. Fold into cooled lemon mixture. Spoon into serving dishes.
Makes 4 cups (1 L).

add to the cooked mixture - Pack evenly in 9x9"
pan. Spread c icing.

title: Grandma's Brownies
directions: Melt 4 sqs. unsweetened chocolate c 1 c butter or marg. Beat 4 eggs until foamy. Gradually add 2 c sugar, mix well. Add 1 tsp vanilla to chocolate mixture. Fold in 1/4 tsp. salt & 1 c flour. Stir in 1 1/2 c unsweetened coconut just to blend.
Pour into greased 9x13 pan. Bake @ 350° - 30 min. until shiny. - Do not overbake.
Glossy Chocolate Frosting for Brownies: Melt 3 sqs. unsweetened chocolate in dbl. boiler. Add to 1 1/2 c icing sugar, 3 tbsp. boiling water, 4 tbsp. butter & 1 tsp. vanilla. Mix until glossy.
notes: Top right: 'Suzanne M.' and '9 A.M. Music group.'
9x13 pan, 350° 30 min - Do not overbake
